decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD leverages some existing customer knowledge but the declining CD format and absent web presence after 2019 suggest the firm cannot learn from weak early results, so it will likely be dropped.

The illustrated music release series requires design and editorial capabilities outside the firm's retail absorptive capacity, and its disappearance from the website signals poor early results, leading to a high probability of dropping.
Reissuing jazz vinyl demands specialized music licensing knowledge the firm lacks, and with no web presence after 2019 the firm cannot interpret or improve the product, so it is likely dropped.

The multi-disc music box set is a complex, high-cost product far from retail expertise, and its absence online after 2019 indicates the firm lacks the absorptive capacity to learn and improve it, making drop very likely.
This generic compilation music CD was only briefly mentioned online and never given a dedicated page, reflecting low absorptive capacity and weak early results, so it is likely dropped.
